targets.old_statement: The passing driver signals and sounds the horn, while the driver being passed must move right and must not speed up.
targets.old_spoken_statement: The passing driver signals and sounds the horn, while the driver being passed must move right and must not speed up.
targets.statement: When passing, you signal your intention and blow the horn to alert the driver ahead; when being passed, you must help by moving to the right edge of the road if the passing driver blows the horn, and you must never increase your speed.
